caseNameFull: Carter v. Forrestal, Secretary of National Defense
attorneys: Claude L. Dawson for petitioner. Solicitor General Perlman for respondent.

opinions.text:
The motion to extend the time to file petition for writ of certiorari is denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Ap*833peals for the District of Columbia Circuit denied.

Claude L. Dawson for petitioner. Solicitor General Perlman for respondent. Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.
